reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: FMO's funding will be provided in two phases (USD 9mln and USD 6mln), making up to USD 15mln altogether. The facility finances expansionary capex to (i) construct a new processing factory (6,000), including cold storage and fast freezing systems, (ii) construct new organic hatcheries, and (iii) the working capital required for certifications and purchasing of organic shrimp. The capex forms part of a larger plan to improve the incomes of ~7,200 smallholder farmers through organic certifications and supplying organic certified PLs and to promote the sustainable management of up to 16,300 hectares of wetlands by promoting sustainable Silvo-aquaculture practices, including mangrove cover expansion.
